entries.fact: DIFF = Previous - Current. VAR = DIFF / Previous. When Previous is zero, VAR is unavailable. Grand-total VAR uses grand-total DIFF divided by grand-total Previous.
The uploaded example reports are layout references, not current sales data. New uploaded sales reports determine quantities and net sales.
MAX uses Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct with Transformers.js and q4 weights. Browser model downloads/cache and available device memory affect startup; this is local inference, not model retraining.
entries.source: Qwen ONNX model card and Transformers.js v3

entries.fact: A browser may expose WebGPU but return no GPU adapter. MAX checks the adapter and falls back to WASM on the CPU if GPU setup fails. CPU inference may be slower.
entries.source: MDN WebGPU and Transformers.js WebGPU guide; MAX runtime implementation

entries.fact: Browser speech recognition has limited support and may send audio to the browser provider's service. Local MAX text inference does not make microphone transcription offline. Typing remains available.
MAX tests a key by requesting the provider's model list. A saved connection is not proof that a paid generation will succeed; the requested model's permissions and API quota still apply.
entries.source: OpenAI model-list reference; MAX connection implementation

entries.fact: MAX's default cloud image model is gpt-image-2.5-sunburst through the Images API; it returns PNG image data. This is separate from the on-device text model and requires API access.
entries.source: OpenAI image-generation guide; MAX creation implementation

entries.fact: SpreadsheetML uses oddHeader/oddFooter on all pages when differentOddEven is false. MAX keeps a repeating grayscale report footer with MG/date and page numbers; its report paper options remain Letter, Legal and Ledger in either orientation.
entries.source: Microsoft Open XML HeaderFooter reference; owner print requirements

entries.fact: The report footer defaults to Downloads. A browser download suggests a filename; the browser and user settings choose the actual destination. CSV exports filtered data and grand totals but has no printed page layout. Excel and PDF retain report headers and footers.
entries.source: MDN anchor download attribute; MAX Report Studio implementation

entries.fact: Excel headers and footers use Times New Roman, with Aptos Display in the body. PDF embeds Liberation Serif and Liberation Sans by default. A supporting browser can request access to installed Times New Roman and Aptos fonts after the owner clicks Report fonts; selected font data is kept on the device.
entries.source: MDN Local Font Access API; MAX Report Studio implementation

entries.fact: ProductMix filenames containing an explicit ISO start/end range identify PMIX reporting dates. Verified report headers also supply metadata; conflicting dates require confirmation. Preview and PDF download use the same document generator. Save report includes source data, filters, layout and header/footer settings in a private portable JSON file.
entries.source: MAX Report Studio source and owner reporting requirements

entries.fact: Compact reports use 8-point detail text, bold category and total rows, and a larger centered title. Excel places the title and date/filter line in its native print header, visible in Page Layout, Print Preview and print. Native header/footer text has a 255-character limit including formatting; overflow filter descriptions remain in the report legend. Wide comparisons repeat the item column on additional printed pages.
entries.source: Microsoft Excel header/footer documentation; applied MAX report exporter

entries.fact: Carry-Out contains W/I Walk-In, C/I Call-In, ONL Online Order, D/T Drive-Thru, KSK Kiosk and DD DoorDash. Dine-In contains BAR, PATIO and DI inside seating. Catering contains CT-DEL delivery, CT-P/U pickup and CT-ONL online. Filters display only source-supported scopes. Menu-level Dine-In or Carry-Out totals cannot establish more detailed subtypes. The report legend explains used abbreviations; All Dining Options refers to all dining scopes present in the uploaded source.
entries.source: Owner reporting requirements; applied source-driven dining filters

entries.fact: Two files with matching table headers and different dates or stores select VS automatically; three or more select side-by-side source columns. Earlier dates are Previous; equal dates use import order, with an explicit reversal control. Columns and legends retain each source date and location. Distinct date intervals are never summed together. DIFF and VAR use source values, and grand-total VAR uses the corresponding grand totals.
entries.source: Owner reporting requirements; applied MAX comparison engine

entries.fact: For supported Toast All levels workbooks, MAX reads every tab and checks item detail against Summary, Items, Menus and Menu groups, excluding gift-card rows from item PMIX; modifier occurrences are checked against the Modifiers tab. A separate modifier quantity view uses actual modifier counts. Modifiers can overlap and are not unique item counts or item net sales.
entries.source: MAX workbook importer and reconciliation checks

entries.fact: All report formats use inches: top 0.85, bottom 0.75, left/right 0.25, header/footer 0.30. The report body aligns left at 0.25 inch; the title stays centered in the native Excel header. Header/footer use Times New Roman. PDF uses the installed font when authorized, with the existing embedded serif fallback.
entries.source: Owner reporting requirements; Microsoft custom margin documentation

entries.fact: Back to formats returns from the live document preview to the collection. The owner can add, edit, save, duplicate, delete and download reusable formats. Excel/PDF/CSV references supply structural layout measurements, not sales data. MAX can suggest constrained settings on the device; optional cloud assistance requires the owner to select paid API mode. Saved format definitions are owner-private and exclude report rows.
entries.source: Applied MAX format library and owner requirements

entries.fact: MAX embeds Jspreadsheet Community Edition 5.0.4 and jSuites 5.12.0, both MIT licensed. The editor supports worksheet tabs, cell edits, copy/paste, undo/redo, widths, row heights, font controls, grayscale shading and borders. Native XLSX parts and formulas are preserved in an edited download; formulas are not executed in the browser and recalculate in Excel. It is a focused workbook editor, not a complete Excel replacement. Reusable format settings can adopt selected cell styles without saving cell data.
entries.source: Jspreadsheet CE repository, license and installed runtime; MAX workbook editor

entries.fact: Category totals and grand totals each have independent Top/Bottom controls. A compact category total can occupy its heading row. Right-side totals always cover all selected location columns. Comparisons retain separate source-period totals at the right; different dates are not combined. Subtotal and grand-total VAR are calculated from aggregate Previous and Current values, never by adding percentages.
entries.source: Owner reporting requirements and applied PMIX calculation/export logic

reviewLimitations: Toast Product Mix documentation could not be retrieved on 2026-09-12. Import changes were verified against supplied format examples and synthetic fixtures; they were not re-certified against current Toast documentation.
dailyReview: Daily documentation and sourced-knowledge review is enabled through Michael’s ChatGPT task. New knowledge is applied only when supported and validated. Model weights do not retrain.
